Restart relaunches a launched emulator with the same arguments and

The adapter reads the executable itself and, optionally, an ELF sibling.
What each toolchain provides:
debug hunks, symbols from the symbol hunks. Breakpoints and stepping by assembly source line.
DWARF from the trailing debug hunk: lines, functions, parameters and locals, globals, struct/array/pointer/enum types, call-frame information for the call stack.
AmigaPorts amiga-gcc with packed Hunk DWARF (

DWARF from the length-prefixed trailing debug hunk, including section-relative references: lines, functions, parameters and locals, globals, types and call-frame information. Tested with GCC 16 and DWARF 2, 4 and 5. Support depends on the linker retaining this container, rather than the GCC version alone.
The hunk file’s symbols plus the ELF’s DWARF through
), including multi-file DWARF 4/5 builds linked with
; ELF sections map onto hunks in section order, as elf2hunk allocates them.

Keep the ELF used by elf2hunk alongside the hunk executable, or name it
explicitly with
. For example, a relocatable build can use:

m68k-amiga-elf-gcc -g -O0 -r -nostdlib main.c worker.c -o program.elf
elf2hunk program.elf program

If a linked Hunk executable contains only symbols and no DWARF carrier,
it supports function breakpoints, symbolized disassembly and a scanned call
stack, but not source lines or locals. Keep debug information through the
link and do not strip the executable. A matching ELF sibling is another
supported way to supply DWARF.

Prefer DWARF 4 or 5 for packed Hunk builds. GCC’s DWARF 2 frame-base
location lists use

The adapter applies the ELF’s debug-section relocations before reading
DWARF, including references between compilation units’ abbreviation and
line tables. Source breakpoints set before LoadSeg are initially unverified;
they bind and emit a

changed event when the program loads.
Selecting DWARF 4 instead of 5 still requires applying these relocations.
A fully linked ELF built with

is also supported. That
option retains relocation records for tools such as elf2hunk; its debug
contents are already resolved by the linker. The adapter preserves those
contents without applying the retained relocations again.

Locals are shown for simple location expressions and one level of
struct/array nesting; optimized code, location lists and DWARF
expressions render as unsupported.
